dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "I should give the family treasure to you, just to be safe."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Mommy's grandma said that it came from her hometown, far, far away. Mommy doesn't remember that place very well, because she got on a boat and left her hometown when she was very little. But maybe this nursery rhyme can help keep the memory of our hometown alive."
